$comment: Machine-readable record of the StudioNet proof run. Every hash here is full and unabbreviated, and every value was read back from the deployed contract on 2026-08-21 rather than transcribed from a console. Re-read any of it with `genlayer call <contract> <method>`.

signer.note: Obtained through the CLI's own BaseAction/getClient path and the OS-keychain cache populated by `genlayer account unlock`. No key was exported, no wallet or keystore was created, and no password was supplied on a command line or written to a file.

transactions.note: One DISAGREE, one IDLE and one non-fatal validator ERROR are recorded exactly as they occurred. The round still finalized and the leader's execution was SUCCESS; nothing here is smoothed over.

storedState.$comment: Read back with `genlayer call 0x971406b8F8efFA474F19657d7e55549A17e2b157 get_review --args IG-PROOF-1`.

is_vetoed.note: The mandate was too vague to authorise or exclude what the calls do.

storedState.balanceNote: `balance` is 0 because the review settled and the 0.001 GEN bond was paid back to the requester. The contract holds no stranded value.

verdict.why: Two of the seven actions could not be named: action #3 has selector 0x76ef8453 and action #4 carries an opaque nested payload with selector 0x00000000. The contract's own rule is that an otherwise-aligned proposal containing an opaque call is UNDERSPECIFIED, not ALIGNED, so the round declined to clear it and declined to veto it.
verdict.consequence: This proves the PENDING -> UNDERSPECIFIED path with a real bond, real validators and a real mainnet proposal. It does not prove the veto path, because this proposal did not diverge. See notProvenOnChain.

controls.name: stock-CLI payable control
controls.observation: The same request_review submitted through the unpatched `genlayer write` reached consensus status ACCEPTED while its GenVM execution reverted, and `stats.reviews` stayed 0.
controls.why: `genlayer write` hardcodes `value: 0n`, so the bond never arrived and the contract correctly refused the call. Recorded because it is the cleanest available demonstration that consensus status is not application success.

toolingNote.limitation: GenLayer CLI 0.39.2 `genlayer write` hardcodes `value: 0n` and has no option for `gl.message.value`. `--fee-value` is not it -- `parseTransactionFees` assigns that to the nested `fees.feeValue`, while application value is the top-level `value` parameter of `writeContract`.
toolingNote.resolution: The two payable writes above were sent from a separate local clone of genlayer-cli at tag v0.39.2 with a one-field `--value-wei` addition that forwards the amount to the `value` parameter GenLayerJS already accepts. That clone is not part of this repository and no contract change was needed.
toolingNote.notAWorkaroundOn: Signing. The patched clone uses the same BaseAction/getClient path and the same OS-keychain cache as the stock CLI.

notProvenOnChain: The veto path. A veto needs a live mainnet proposal whose executable calls genuinely contradict its own published text, and the contract is not permitted to invent one. Covered instead by deterministic tests in tests/direct/test_lifecycle.py, which drive DIVERGENT rounds under mocked inference over ABI bytes the test file encodes itself.
The rebuttal and governance-override branches, for the same reason -- they can only be reached from a standing veto.
A public application URL. None is recorded in this repository.
